Kikongo perfective active, perfective passive and applicative suffixes: the suffix consonant, [d] before [i] and [l] before other vowels, is [n] after a nasal anywhere to its left in the stem; prefixes (m-, n-, tu-, ma-, ku-, wu-) stand outside the stem domain. The underlying field gives the stem with the suffix consonant in its oral alternant.
